rules.capturePolicy: Real native app captures only. No invented balances, transactions, awards, or interface features.
rules.copyPolicy: Action-led feature copy; no fake tappable download buttons, financial promises, prices, or rankings.
rules.devicePolicy: iOS captures in iPhone presentations; Android captures in Android presentations; native iPad captures in tablet presentations.
rules.figmaPolicy: Editable typography, vector device shells and brand assets; actual screenshot images remain replaceable image fills.
